The petitioners, vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, seek quashing of FIR No.356/2019 dated 02.04.2019 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Mangol Puri, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Settlement Deed dated 05.04.2023 arrived at between the parties.

2. This petition is accompanied by the Settlement Deed dated 05.04.2023 [Annexure-P2.] and is also supported by affidavits of petitioners nos.1,3,4 and 5 and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/12/2023 at 00:30:39 3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner no.2 has since expired on 28.02.2022 and the Death Certificate has been placed on record.
4. In view of the submission made, the proceedings against petitioner no.2 stand abated.
5. Petitioner nos. 1, 3, 4 and 5 as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.

sentences.text: 1 6. Issue Notice.
7. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
8. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 21.08.2023.

She further affirms the Settlement Deed dated 05.04.2023 whereby the petitioner no.1 has already paid her a sum of Rs.4,00,000/- and the remaining amount of Rs.1,50,000/- has been handed over to the respondent no. 2 vide DD no.309443 dated 20.10.2023 issued on Punjab National Bank in full and final settlement of all her claims including alimony,
maintenance (present, past and future), stridhan etc.
She states that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

9. In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi & Ors. Vs.
